description: Lists Content Autopilot run history, newest first: what each run made, or why it failed or was skipped. Use when the user asks what an automation produced, whether runs worked, or why nothing was made. Not for task settings (use get_autopilot_task). Returns runs with outcome, time, task ID, the new item's ID or the reason, plus has_more.

event_type.description: Run outcome to filter by: success = content made; failed = the run errored; skipped_limit = skipped for content minutes or the daily run cap; skipped_premium_lost = skipped because premium stock is no longer on the plan.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

task_id.description: Only runs of this task. Get it from list_autopilot_tasks. Omit for all of the team's tasks.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_autopilot_events
title: List content automation runs
